svg.text: Every object is a piece of the maths; shape, motion and sound carry each meaning too, never colour alone
a warm crust, a berry, apple
a soft thump on the board
a wedge; its size is its name
a click per dot; a 'ting' when
a tick for every piece as a
a paper rustle when it closes
a snap when a piece fits
a tray of 12 moulds; a fence
a long baguette along the rail
the oven's dial with a number
a rising or a falling whistle
a chocolate slab of 10 rows of
the dough sighs when it is
a warm light in a cottage
crumbs from a pie cut wrong go
